title: Pag Susulatan nang Dalauang Binibini na si Urbana at ni Feliza
summary: "Pag Susulatan nang Dalauang Binibini na si Urbana at ni Feliza" by Modesto de Castro is an epistolary work written in the first half of the 19th century.
